Finex hopes to encourage most of its employees to work from home so it can close its large office
building in the city centre and rent a smaller one.
In your own opinion, explain

typical Olympic sports.

parts.text:
Explain why the International Olympic Committee has added new sports such as skateboarding
and surfing to future Olympic Games.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Using the information in the material and your own knowledge, state three reasons why the
sportsmen, previously against surfing and climbing becoming Olympic sports, are now hoping
to become Olympians.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Using your own knowledge, suggest why some countries may choose to host large
sporting events, such as the Olympic Games or the football World Cup.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Using your own knowledge, suggest what might be the challenges for a country of
hosting a large sporting event, such as the Olympic Games.
